## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, cookies, private media or sensitive local paths in source/logs/fixtures.
- [ ] Remote content stays untrusted and cannot bypass permission/IPC boundaries.
- [ ] No fake success, mock-only production path, dead button or unsupported capability presented as working.
- [ ] Product/provider policy and third-party notices remain valid.
